dialogue.intro: One final game, brother? And this time, enjoy every move.
dialogue.victory: Beautifully played. Not every move needs to be perfect.
dialogue.defeat: Even mistakes can become something beautiful. Shall we try again?
dialogue.draw: Perhaps balance is our answer. One more game?

dialogue_de.intro: Eine letzte Partie, Bruder? Und diesmal genieße jeden Zug.
dialogue_de.victory: Wunderschön gespielt. Nicht jeder Zug muss perfekt sein.
dialogue_de.defeat: Auch aus Fehlern kann etwas Schönes entstehen. Versuchen wir es noch einmal?
dialogue_de.draw: Vielleicht ist Gleichgewicht unsere Antwort. Noch eine Partie?

dialogue_pt.intro: Uma última partida, irmão? E desta vez, desfruta de cada jogada.
dialogue_pt.victory: Jogaste lindamente. Nem todas as jogadas têm de ser perfeitas.
dialogue_pt.defeat: Até os erros podem tornar-se algo belo. Tentamos novamente?
dialogue_pt.draw: Talvez o equilíbrio seja a resposta. Mais uma partida?
